page_title: KOL 1-2 WOL | FC Koln v Wolfsburg 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+8' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+8' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and FC Koln will have a corner.
90+7' The ratio of the ball possession is 52:48.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
90+4' The yellow card goes to Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg).

90+4' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
90+4' Poor challenge! Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle.
90+3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
89' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
87' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is able to continue to play.
85' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) replacing Lovro Majer.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) for Vaclav Cerny.
84' The game is interrupted now, Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
83' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
79' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
78' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
78' The corner is swung in but FC Koln can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

78' The game is pretty dull as FC Koln are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. It will be a corner kick for FC Koln.
77' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Florian Kainz is replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
77' Substitution. Dejan Ljubicic leaves the pitch and is replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
75' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
72' 1 - 2 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
72' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Marvin Schwabe makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
71' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals.
69' Substitution. Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) in, Rasmus Carstensen out.
69' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln) replaces Eric Martel.
66' The possession of the ball – 53:47.

65' That was absolutely fantastic! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
64' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Here is a change. Nicolas Cozza is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
62' Substitution. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) has come on for Yannick Gerhardt.
62' 1 - 1 Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
58' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.
58' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
57' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' 1 - 0 Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the left post!

53' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a throw-in.
52' Matthias Jollenbeck blows the whistle, Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul.
51' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
49' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' A cross into the box from Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) is cleared. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will take a throw-in.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
45' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg). Matthias Jollenbeck saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
44' Marvin Schwabe is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg). Easy save!

42' Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolfsburg.
41' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and FC Koln will take a throw-in.
38' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:3.
36' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Koen Casteels makes a difficult save to deny Julian Chabot (1. FC Koln), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box.
33' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

33' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Good defending. Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) tries to find Rasmus Carstensen inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
28' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
27' Steffen Baumgart is forced to make a change. Davie Selke is unable to continue due to injury, Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) comes on.
27' The injury to Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
26' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

25' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
24' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball in, but Marvin Schwabe comfortably gathers the ball.
23' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is adjudged offside.
22' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) works the corner short.
22' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' 56:44 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the left of the goal.
19' FC Koln take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' FC Koln keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.
16' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
16' Marvin Schwabe produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper.
15' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Nicolas Cozza (Wolfsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
12' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
10' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
10' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Marvin Schwabe pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg). Great goalkeeping!
7' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Matthias Jollenbeck immediately signals a free kick.
6' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
4' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner with a short pass.

4' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
FC Koln will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Matthias Jollenbeck.
